item.title: Eastern Sydney beaches close after whale carcass washes up
item.description: A dead whale washes up on rocky shoreline in Sydney's east, prompting Randwick Council to close two popular beaches. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.description: Principals, the education union and a parent at a school with potholes in its playground have cautiously welcomed a deal between Victoria and the Commonwealth to fully fund state schools. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: Mine on tropical island plans to pump pit water into ocean
item.description: The $100 million plan has approval from the NT government and local traditional owners, and comes as financial challenges mount at the mine. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: Man United captain branded 'disgrace' for comments following latest loss
item.description: Bruno Fernandes takes aim at Michael Carrick as Manchester United's horrible start to the season goes from bad to worse in the Champions League. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: Why Tesla's new flying car likely won't be seen in Australia any time soon

item.title: House prices falling in every Australian capital city for first time in 15 years
item.description: House prices in Sydney are at a two-year low after falling 4.7% in the September quarter to $1.66m, according to Domain report Get our breaking news email , free app or daily news podcast House prices are falling across every capital city for the first time in 15 years and the second time on record, according to figures from Domain’s September Quarter 2026 House Price report. House prices in Sydney are at a two-year low after falling 4.7% in the September quarter, to $1.66m. Continue reading... Fuente: The Guardian - World.

item.title: Why the humble rabbit might be Australia's worst introduced species
item.description: The 19th-century pastoralist Thomas Austin was homesick. He yearned for the pastimes of his home in England—especially rabbit hunting. He asked his family to send him some rabbits. Fuente: Phys.org.

item.title: Motorists rescued by members of the public as rain hits parts of Qld
item.description: Motorists have been rescued by members of the public from flooded roads as heavy rain soaks south-east and central Queensland overnight. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: Putin agrees to resume peace talks with Ukraine and US
item.description: The Kremlin said the new three-way peace talks could take place in Abu Dhabi and would be focused on how to guarantee the security of Ukraine and Russia once the war ends. item.description: One in four Australian workers have been underpaid their super — many, along with industry experts, are calling on the tax office to be more "proactive" in addressing the billions that goes unrecovered each year. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: Live: AFP expects to see increase in youth radicalisation

item.title: ‘Huge moment’: long-awaited extension to Sydney’s metro line to open next week
item.description: The south-west metro extension will open on Friday 30 October, more than two years after the former T3 heavy rail line closed Get our breaking news email , free app or daily news podcast A long-awaited extension to Sydney’s metro line will open next week, bringing an end to more than two years of replacement buses for residents in the city’s south-west. In a video shared on Instagram on Thursday morning, the New South Wales premier, Chris Minns, announced that the south-west metro extension would open on Friday 30 October. In a statement, the government said the first service would commence… Fuente: The Guardian - World.

item.title: NSW passes ‘human compost’ laws with several MPs saying they will utilise practice after they die
item.description: Australia-first laws provide a third legal option other than burial and cremation for the treatment of bodies Get our breaking news email , free app or daily news podcast Several New South Wales MPs say they want their own bodies turned into “human compost” after Australian-first laws were passed allowing the unusual practice.
